thread:
Priya: getting customer pings about dashboard charts being slow since the 07:30 deploy. LCP + total-blocking-time spiked. RUM shows lots of repeat GETs for same chunk keys and several 429s on /api/prefetch :frowning:
Owen: I see it too. Trace sample: client requests chunk A -> 404 from edge -> fetch origin -> large parse -> render. Then subsequent chart tiles throttle on prefetch 429s and fall back to sync fetch.
Fern: Deploy note: rolled routing-policy v3 at 07:28 to enable cross-region balancing and lower cold-starts. status-bot: deploy 7101234000 (routing-policy-v3) completed by Owen at 07:28:16 UTC
Samir: cross-region balancing changed pool assignment heuristics. It can flip pool hints mid-session which invalidates signed asset keys we bake with pool id. That causes edge misses + origin fetches -> bigger bundles parsed on client.
Priya: exact symptom: many tiles request prefixes simultaneously, prefetch quota triggers 429s, fallback route mapping sends requests to different hosts -> kvcache misses. double whammy.
Owen: logs snippet:
```
[07:32:05] WARN asset: edge-miss path=/static/js/chunk-tiles-abc.js pool=eu-1
[07:32:05] WARN route-quota: route=/api/prefetch code=429 active=124 limit=100
[07:32:06] INFO kvcache: miss key=tile:usr42:prefix host=us-3
```
Fern: mitigation proposals:
- rollback routing-policy v3 (fast)
- decouple signed asset key from runtime pool (longer)
- add session affinity header/cookie so client keeps same pool token (medium)
- add a runtime throttle so SRE can dampen prefetch without deploy (fast)
Owen: I'd push rollback + runtime throttle. Rolling back gives immediate relief so CDN edge hits stable, throttle avoids 429 cascades.
Samir: agree. Also add a small telemetry tag `pool_transition=true` when we see a pool change so we can quantify how often it flips per session.
Priya: can we also temporarily increase prefetch concurrency limit by 50% to stop cascade while rollback is in progress? Risk: could spike origin load.
Fern: yes we can, but prefer throttle + rollback. I'll flip rollback now. Also filing a follow-up to make signed URLs include a stable asset token independent of pool mapping (INF-3010).
status-bot: initiating rollback 7101234000 -> intent=rollback_by_Fern at 07:35:12 UTC
Owen: rollback done 07:36:55 UTC. Initial RUM shows LCP back down but leaving prefetch throttle enabled for 20m.
Samir: pushed telemetry change to tag pool_transitions; will let it collect for an hour and then summarize. Also adding a small dashboard to show chunk edge-miss rate and prefetch 429s by region.
Priya: next steps: Fern -> RFC to decouple signed asset keys + timeline; Owen -> add runtime toggle for prefetch throttle; Samir -> dashboard + telemetry marker; I'll coordinate a controlled canary with affinity header once RFC lands. ETA: sync in 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
